# DB Astro Suite

DB Astro Suite is a free, professional collection of social-media focused astrophotography tools
built with Angular. The suite is designed around a single idea: go from sensor to social — take
your raw astrophotography captures and turn them into shareable, visually polished content.

## Mission
"From Sensor to Social" — bridging the gap between raw astrophotography data and shareable
social media content through automation and high-fidelity generation.

## Tools in the Suite

### Starwizz
A free browser-based 4K starfield and galaxy animation generator.
- Live: https://dbastrosuite.com/starwizz/
- LLMs: https://dbastrosuite.com/starwizz/llms.txt
- Features: real-time starfield simulation, natural star colors with twinkle and
  diffraction spikes, galaxy background rendering, shooting stars,
  in-browser 4K video recording and download via MediaRecorder API

### Astrogram
A free astrophotography exposure card generator for Instagram and social media.
- Live: https://dbastrosuite.com/astrogram/
- LLMs: https://dbastrosuite.com/astrogram/llms.txt
- Features: per-filter integration time tracking (L, Ha, OIII, SII, R, G, B), circular
  progress ring visualization, plate solving with WCS annotation overlay (Messier, NGC, IC,
  Tycho-2 catalogs), Bortle scale selector, high-quality JPEG export

### AstroSpike
A free browser-based diffraction-spike studio for astrophotography images.
- Live: https://dbastrosuite.com/astrospike/
- LLMs: https://dbastrosuite.com/astrospike/llms.txt
- Features: automatic client-side star detection (background modelling, noise thresholding,
  seed extraction inside merged star/nebula regions, hot-pixel, satellite-trail, and
  galaxy-core rejection), additive spike rendering with length and intensity scaled by
  measured star brightness, per-star colour sampling, chromatic arm gradients, four style
  presets (Subtle, Classic, JWST, and a spike-free Diffusion bloom mode), 4- or 6-spike
  toggle, per-star tuning (length, brightness, rotation, diffusion), click toggling plus
  manual star placement and drag-to-move, before/after comparison, PNG/JPEG export at the
  source image's native resolution, and a spikes-only transparent PNG layer export for
  compositing over 16-bit masters
- Privacy: fully client-side — images are never uploaded to any server
- Opens on a bundled Pleiades (desktop) or Cygnus Wall (mobile) sample so it can be tried
  without an image at hand

### Sortronomy (CLI)
A single-binary Go wizard for automated astrophotography dataset organisation.
- Live: https://dbastrosuite.com/tool/sortronomy
- Purpose: organises FITS captures by camera, focal length, target, session date, and filter,
  read straight from the FITS headers — works with ASIAIR, N.I.N.A., SharpCap, Ekos/KStars,
  SGP, Voyager, and APT with zero configuration
- Command: `sortronomy` (interactive wizard — no flags to remember)
- Language: Go

## Tech Stack
- **Framework**: Angular 21 (Standalone Components, Signals)
- **Meta-framework (Hub)**: AnalogJS (SSR/SSG for Angular)
- **Styling**: TailwindCSS 4
- **CLI**: Go
